items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person. Walking for 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain: 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Only 12.5% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is good because sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Keep having most of your dinners before 8 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.9 hours, which is a good habit to keep. In the program, 50.0% of nights reached 13 hours, which may be worth aiming for.
